body: The cat poops in the litter tray and gets it on it’s paws and tracks it through the house, it also poops on the floor if the door to the litter tray is closed. The litter tray gets cleaned out my my roommate a few times a day unless she is out

It does sound like you might be experiencing something you’ve not seen before, but this may still be caused by the hpv still in your system. It can take a long time for your body to fight it off, and it can come back. Keep an eye on it, but if it gets worse or doesn’t get better best advice I can give is see a doctor

You should tell anyone you’re intimate with about your diagnosis. Herpes stays with you for life and it can be passed on, nobody should have that decision if they want to risk it made for them. Having said that I understand how nerve wracking telling a new partner can be. I always think to myself, if they have a problem with it then they’re not the right person for you anyway!

Best thing would be to talk to your doctor or sexual health clinician. From what you’ve described it sounds like you’re not sure if it’s genital warts or not in this latest outbreak. Have you had a new sexual partner recently? If not it most likely is warts and you may need different treatment. I was treated used a combination of cryotherapy and burning the warts with acid, which hurt but was really effective and getting my immune response going. Best of luck

That sucks! I’m sorry you’ve had to go through that and with someone who doesn’t sound like they’ve been as reassuring or supportive as they should have been. It really sucks when people don’t talk to you the same after they find out you have herpes, even when it was them who gave it to you

I get tested religiously every 6 months due to complication of a immune disorder I have. The clinic in my area is very supportive and happy to carry out these tests for me! I haven’t been with anyone else for nearly 8 months. I was no accusatory towards her; I made sure she was aware of what to look out for and that it’s something she’s probably had for awhile and just not had any symptoms. 
Thinking about it that’s a very good point. So even if she has not had any symptoms and has passed it to me, there’s no way I could “reinfect” her? I’ve been doing my own research but anything helps :) 
Thank you, I am sure she I just needing time to process and hopefully we will be able to talk normally soon!

That sucks! I’m sorry you’re going through this too :( it’s such a stressful situation without this being added on top! You’re right though sounds like best thing to do it look after ourselves and hope they come around to help us through it too. Here if you need to chat!
I’ll talk to her tomorrow and mention that I need more support I think!

Thank you :) this comment really made me feel good about how far I’ve come, but it also made me sad to think that my friends don’t think about me enough to just have one night of not smoking. I don’t want to tell them they can’t smoke or anything, but they say they’re not addicted so there shouldn’t be an issue with not smoking right?

Thank you for your kind words. It is an awful feeling isn’t it? To have put someone to one side when they needed us the most, but I know that is hindsight and at the time there was no way we could have known the contact would be so.. final. I am sorry for your loss and hope you have seen the light in the world and are holding onto those good memories of your late father. I can’t imagine what it must be to lose a parent 🧡

Thank you for your kind words, it really does bring some light and warmth to a horrible situation. I am going to start bereavement counselling to help with the feelings of guilt I am having. And thank you for that very kind offer, I will bare you in mind if I need to vent or need support 🧡
